L4·N3980unmasked layer
Fires mainly on word-final sub-word fragments that complete a multi-token word (e.g. "Cor|oner", "Har|row", "Marg|are|tsbury", "man|ure"), with weaker hits on mid-sentence function/adverb words like " whether" and " still"; other suffix pieces ("umper", "uary", "mar") strongly suppress it, so it is a surface-form/tokenization-position feature rather than a semantic one.
